'''Ronald Maier''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[1999 GenCon Open]] on 7 August 1999 with Death Star / Jabba's Palace aliens, according to Mike Fitzgerald's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d13">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-20-gen-con-milwaukee-wi-8-7-99d13/ gen-con-milwaukee-wi-8-7-99], DeckTech (Mike "Iceman" Fitzgerald, 20 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-20-gen-con-milwaukee-wi-8-7-99d13/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
